_comment: v7 scout oracle fixture. Expected output of the unified cross-file resolveStruct edge-resolver when anchored at the given consumer.rs site, walking to depth 2. Fields AND methods, each type's real (non-guessable) names. The build's oracle asserts the derived shape is a superset of `must_derive` and contains none of `must_not_invent`. domain.rs/consumer.rs are the resolvable two-file crate; none of these defs live in consumer.rs.

bound.note: Order->Customer->Address is depth 2; Region (depth 3) is beyond the bound and NOT required.

cross_crate_note: The rust-scratch playground (crates/playground/src/autocontext.rs over crate atlas) covers the cross-CRATE leg (Tile.subtended_children, Stripe.enroll_tile). It is kept there, not duplicated here, because a self-contained oracle fixture must not depend on an external crate. The cross-crate member-list caveat (membersOfType needs the source file open; hoverSurface does not) is the risk that leg's oracle must pin.
